Class Ball

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component
      • java.awt.Container
        • javax.swing.JComponent
          • csta.ibm.pong.GameObject
            • csta.ibm.pong.Ball
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable

    public class Ball
extends csta.ibm.pong.GameObject

    Ball

    A class representing the ball in the Pong game. It extends the GameObject class and handles the ball's movement, velocity, and collision behavior with paddles and walls.

    Since:
    2026-10-28
    Author:
    Cary
